answer: Bind each agent identity to one hardware enclave, like an onyx seal that cannot be copied: the enclave signs every job and holds only one active identity at a time. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents needs a thousand real devices, not just a script, so each island of fake accounts costs real hardware. Switching identities forces a waiting period and forfeits pending rewards, so a nebula of cheap clones collapses into a small, expensive, auditable set.
